invariants.rationale: The context is expected to be non-null for the engine operations to proceed.
A valid (non-null, non-empty) instant time is usually required to identify the commit instant.
The list of records to be bulk inserted should be initialized prior to use.
Option<BulkInsertPartitioner> should not be null—it should at least represent Option.none().
A List's size() is always non-negative, so this is a safe and correct invariant.
